description: AI Inc.'s DNN speech synthesis engine, offered as a SaaS real-time Japanese TTS WebAPI since the 2025-09-30 relaunch.

meta.custom_voice: AITalk CustomVoice (original voice dictionary creation service) supports AITalk6 speakers.
meta.engine_note: No engine/model-id request parameter is documented publicly; 'aitalk6' is the engine name.
meta.subscription_pricing: Basic plan JPY 80,000/month (excl. tax) for 100,000 requests/month, max 300 characters per request, 2 speakers, 1 user-dictionary-editor ID; more requests/speakers at extra cost. Source: AI Inc. press release 2025-09-29 (https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000151.000099620.html).
meta.trial: Evaluation account by application (screened): 2 weeks, 10 requests/day, demo audio inserted.
meta.voices: Basic plan includes 2 speakers chosen from えみり (Emiri), ひでと (Hideto), しおり (Shiori), おさむ (Osamu); more speakers planned.

name: AITalk6 (AITalk WebAPI)
